provenance: x402 specification v2 section 5.5, Settlement and Refusal Identity Invariant, as proposed in x402-foundation/x402 pull request 3776, the same text as the 22 frozen files in vectors/attempt-identity

added on 2026-11-20 by github.com/holistis after a run that planted 23 mistakes in our own implementation showed that four rules were checked by neither the 22 frozen files, the harness nor the other tests of this repository: deflate, the order of several encodings, the case of a charset name and a +json media type
these files are not part of the 22 frozen files and change none of them; nobody outside this project has checked these values yet
encodes: The charset name is read without regard to case: ISO-8859-1 in capitals is Latin-1, so byte 0x80 is the control character U+0080 and not the euro sign. The expected value was computed by two separately written implementations, one in JavaScript and one in Python (standard library only), that agree.
description: A known answer for a canonical member.
limits: The existing file for ISO-8859-1 uses a lower-case name; this one adds the capitals. Other charset names are not covered.
